coverage.sum_is_not_reconstructible: The published no-prescreen column sums to 16.676 over all 23 tasks, but only 7 per-task values are transcribed. A suite-sum comparison is therefore NOT possible from this table.

blockers.consequence: The 3x250 pilot would charge up to 1000 calls/task (~3000 total, 4x the declared 750), and auc_top10_development_1000 would be normalized by 1000 rather than 250.
blockers.evidence: MEASURED from the pinned runtime and campaign loop
blockers.finding: The corrected contract declares charged_calls_per_task=250, but execute_task builds its ledger with budget=QUERY_BUDGET=1000 and never reads contract['budget']. run_program_campaign's only call-count authority is ledger.remaining; stagnation_rounds is None, so the stagnation break is disabled and the wall-clock break is the only other exit. 64 rounds x 16 queries + 16 init = 1040 > 1000, so the ledger binds at 1000.
blockers.not_fixed_here: editing it would break the pinned launch chain

blockers.evidence: MEASURED: execute_task raises on any task outside TASKS
blockers.finding: TASKS is a 3-tuple and execute_task raises 'task is outside the PMO-v1 three-task lock'. TASK_ROLES would also KeyError for a new task.
10,000 calls needs 624 rounds; capacity is 64 rounds = 1040 calls. Both MAX_ROUNDS and QUERY_BUDGET must rise for an official-budget run.

blockers.evidence: MEASURED: CONTRACT is a module constant read by load_contract
blockers.finding: load_contract always reads configs/pmo_population_controller_v1.json. The manifests written here are sealed PLANNING artifacts that specify the ladder and its arithmetic; they are not drop-in runtime contracts.

controller_task_blindness.identical_across_tasks: configuration() cannot vary by task: its only argument is `seed`, and execute_task calls it as configuration(contract['controller']['seed']) with no task argument.
controller_task_blindness.method: executed configuration() and searched the produced config for task names

task_dependent_elsewhere_by_design.TASK_ROLES[task_name]: reporting label only; KeyError outside the lock

runtime_capability_measured.note: execute_task builds its ledger with budget=QUERY_BUDGET and computes the AUC with budget=QUERY_BUDGET. It never reads contract['budget'], so the contract's charged_calls_per_task is a declaration the runtime does not enforce.

staleness.why: This plan pins the live launch chain by content hash. The chain was observed CHANGING during preparation (another session was editing it), so these pins can go stale. Re-run tools/build_pmo_scale_up_plan.py --apply immediately before acting on it; the builder is deterministic, so an unchanged tree reproduces byte-identical artifacts.

provenance.note: PyTDC does not define the PMO suite; it ships the oracles. Suite membership is taken from two independent published transcriptions that agree exactly.
